content: The rockslide is gone (day 5) — the corridor is open. The path is x=11 up to y=3, then west to x=6, then north to y=1, then east to x=11,y=1. Let me route through the gap.

args.approach: Day 5: rockslide cleared. The corridor is a zigzag — x=11 north to y=3, west along y=3 to x=6, north to y=1, then east along y=1 to the chest at (11,1). Then try the remaining button ids ("open", "grab", "click") on the chest.
